title.fa: Worker process ‏{instance} کمتر از یک ساعت پیش شروع شده است
title.en: Worker process of {instance} started less than an hour ago

explanation.fa: فرایند w3wp این Pool در {pool.wp_youngest_age_s} ثانیه پیش شروع شده و با زمان‌بندی Recycle ({pool.restart_schedule}) منطبق نیست؛ ممکن است Crash یا Recycle ناخواسته باشد.
explanation.en: The pool's w3wp started {pool.wp_youngest_age_s} s ago, outside its recycle schedule ({pool.restart_schedule}); it may have crashed or recycled unexpectedly.

recommendation.fa: رخدادهای WAS و Application Error همان زمان را بررسی کنید.
recommendation.en: Check WAS and Application Error events around that time.

source.citation: General guidance (Microsoft IIS / Windows documentation, common practice)
